$schema.description: JSON Schema for this configuration file.

rules.description: Rules and rule presets to use. Each rule package must be installed.

sharedOptions.description: Options shared by all rules. Rules can read them via `context.sharedOptions`.

id.description: Rule package name or its short name. For example, "@scope/secretlint-rule-example" or "@scope/example", "secretlint-rule-example" or "example".

options.description: Options for the rule. See the rule documentation. Default: {}

disabled.description: If true, disable the rule. Default: false

allowMessageIds.description: Message ids to suppress. Message ids are defined in each rule.

severity.description: Severity level for the rule. Default: "error"

id.description: Rule preset package name or its short name. For example, "@secretlint/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend" or "@secretlint/preset-recommend".

options.description: Options for the rule preset. See the preset documentation. Default: {}

disabled.description: If true, disable the rule preset. Default: false

rules.description: Configuration for rules in the preset. Each id must be a rule in the preset.
